procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Subjective
Type 1 diabetes recheck. Using the full correction dose at dinner most nights since December. Evening numbers now mostly under 200. Fasting 120s to 170s. No lows under 60. Eye exam was last week at her optometrist, she was told no changes; asked her to have them send it.

Objective
Vitals reviewed. Comfortable. Feet: no lesions, sensation intact.

Assessment and plan
1. DM1 - slightly better on the meter. A1c and BMP drawn.
2. Hypothyroidism - on levothyroxine 88, TSH normal in September.
Next in about 3 months, video is fine.

documents.title: Eye exam report
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Hi Hailey, we haven't received the report from your eye exam in February. Could you send us the name of the office, or ask them to fax it to us? Thank you.

documents.title: RE: Eye exam report
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Same place as last year. They told me everything looked normal, no diabetes damage. I'll call them again.

procedures.procedure: Telehealth visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Video Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Video visit, she is at home, two identifiers verified.

Feb A1c a touch lower than September. Since then sugars about the same per her report; she forgot to upload the meter. No hypoglycemia needing help. No symptoms of thyroid over- or under-replacement.

Eye report from February still not here despite her calling; she was told it was normal. Documented as patient-reported.

Plan: continue all meds. Physical in September with Pap and full labs. Message me the meter download when she can.

documents.title: Refill request
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pharmacy refill request: levothyroxine 88 mcg #90 with 3 refills. Last TSH 9/2023 normal, physical scheduled 9/17. Routed to PCP, approved and sent.

reports.text: Specimen: liquid-based cervical cytology with high-risk HPV co-testing. Specimen adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation; transformation zone component present. Interpretation: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. High-risk HPV: not detected.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
32 y/o woman, annual.

No interval illness. Same job. Married, lives with her husband. No tobacco, no alcohol.
Diabetes: checks 2-4x a day; describes highs mainly after dinner still. No severe lows. Eye exam Feb, normal per pt, report never sent.
Thyroid: fine. Mood fine, PHQ-2 1 (some tiredness).

Meds unchanged: glargine 24 units nightly, lispro scale AC, levothyroxine 88, prenatal vitamin. NKDA.

PE: NAD. HEENT clear. Thyroid smooth, not enlarged. RRR, no murmur. CTAB. Abdomen benign. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, vaginal mucosa normal, cervix without lesions; Pap/HPV collected. Extremities without edema. Feet: intact skin, monofilament normal, pulses 2+.

A/P
- Health maintenance: Pap with HPV today. Flu and COVID in October. Tdap 2019.
- DM1: labs today. If A1c isn't moving, revisit an endocrinology referral or a sensor; she would like to think about it.
- Hypothyroid: TSH.
RTC December.

documents.title: Pap and lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Hailey, your Pap smear is normal and HPV was not detected, so the next one isn't due for 5 years. Blood work is normal apart from the A1c, which jumped back up from February. Thyroid level is good. See you in December.

documents.title: Immunizations
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Afebrile, no acute illness. Flu (trivalent 2024-25) given IM left arm, COVID 2024-25 given IM right arm. No issues after 15 minutes.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
DM1 visit. Rough fall: short-staffed at work, eating at her desk, often forgets the lunch dose. Meter: mid-day and dinner readings 200-280 on many days, fasting 150-190. No lows.

Well appearing. Feet normal.

A1c drawn. Poorly controlled type 1 diabetes; she knows and is frustrated. Talked about setting a phone alarm for the lunch dose. She'd like to revisit endocrine/sensor after the holidays, will message. Continue glargine 24 units and lispro scale. 3 months.

documents.title: A1c
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your A1c is still high, close to where it was in September, which fits the tough fall you described. Let's regroup after the holidays. Message me whenever you're ready to talk about next steps.
